card.fires_on: Fires on a word or word-part that sits in the middle of a longer term and is followed by a noun or a continuing phrase, such as 'antithrombot|ic' before 'medications' or 'greater than 3 times' in lab thresholds. It appears in drug-label text with a few web-text cases.
